Latest: Amazon's 2026 Fall Prime Day Deals officially end at midnight Pacific Time, this is your last chance, don't miss out on your favorite deals.

2026 Fall Prime Day deals are in full swing, with millions of items on sale, including one of the lowest prices ever for AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and the all-new M6 Mac mini lineup hitting all-time lows with up to $150 off. Add to that the new Mac Studio at nearly $200 off, plus the M5 MacBook Air lineup at its lowest prices in months with $200 off most configurations.

The all-new Apple Watch Series 12 lineup is on sale for the first time ever at new low prices, with Apple Watch Ultra 4 also down nearly $100, plus first-ever deals on Apple's new Magic Keyboard and the 2026 iPhone 18 Pro case lineup. Keep scrolling for full details, along with the Fall Prime Day deals on chargers, accessories, power stations, e-bikes, apparel and more.
